role-question|A customer asked who should sign their handover.|Do you handle handover approvals?|No idea. Could a delivery manager sign this? I have not checked the policy.|-|none|-

units|The dashboard shows temperatures without units.|Should the report append a unit?|For every facilities report, use Celsius and include the unit in the label.|-|add|Celsius
